ch1.zh:
1. 综合第一：Claude Fable 5.2。AA 指数 65，Vals Index 71.31%，两个独立榜单都第一。〔高〕
  2. 第二、第三：GPT-6.2 Astra（AA 62）、Gemini 4 Neon（AA 61）。Vals Index 上 Neon 70.87% 第二，Astra 67.66% 第八。〔高〕
  3. Google 四个里选 Neon。$3 / $15，AA 61，高于 Carbon 的 60。Carbon 12 月 1 日从 $2 / $10 涨到 $4 / $20。〔高〕
  4. 旗舰同价不同耗。Fable 5.2 和 GPT-6.2 Astra 都是 $8 / $40。跑完 AA 指数，Fable 每题 $26.54，Astra 每题 $4.00。〔高〕
  5. $2 / $10 档：GPT-6.2 Sol（AA 57）、Sonnet 5.5（55，Vals Index 第三）、GPT-6.1 Sol（55）。〔高〕
  6. 最低价 $0.10 / $0.50：Haiku 5.5（AA 36）、GPT-6 Luna（28）。〔高〕
  7. Mythos 5.2 专项：CVE Rediscovery 89.6%，上一代 78.3%。ExploitGym 39.2%，低于 Carbon 的 53.5%。见表 2-2。〔中〕
  8. 内部还有更强的 Model 4：AECI 178.78，Mythos 5.2 是 177.12。没有发布。〔高〕
  9. 大厂与开源里最强：Muse Wonder Full，AA 50。比前沿第一 Fable 5.2（65）低 15。它没有 API，只在 Meta 的订阅里用；能用 API 调的最强是 Kimi K3.1 Pro（46），低 19。〔高〕
  10. 最便宜一档 $0.10 / $0.50：Muse Ember 和 Haiku 5.5 打平。AA 都是 36。Vals Index 上 Ember 60.48%、Haiku 58.73%，每题成本 $0.15 对 $3.17，Ember 便宜约 20 倍。见图 4-4。〔高〕
  11. 开放权重第一：Kimi K3.1 Pro，AA 46。比第二名 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017（33）高 13。但它用 Moonshot 自定义的许可证：收入超 2,000 万美元的 MaaS 要另签协议。MIT 许可里最强的是 V4.1-Flash-1017。见表 3-1。〔高〕
ch1.en:
1. Best overall: Claude Fable 5.2. AA Index 65 and Vals Index 71.31%, first on both independent leaderboards. [high]
  2. Second and third: GPT-6.2 Astra (AA 62) and Gemini 4 Neon (AA 61). On the Vals Index, Neon is second at 70.87% and Astra eighth at 67.66%. [high]
  3. Of Google's four, pick Neon. $3 / $15 and AA 61, ahead of Carbon's 60. Carbon goes from $2 / $10 to $4 / $20 on December 1. [high]
  4. Same flagship price, very different bills. Fable 5.2 and GPT-6.2 Astra are both $8 / $40, yet a full AA Index run costs $26.54 per task on Fable and $4.00 on Astra. [high]
  5. At $2 / $10: GPT-6.2 Sol (AA 57), Sonnet 5.5 (55, third on the Vals Index), GPT-6.1 Sol (55). [high]
  6. Cheapest, at $0.10 / $0.50: Haiku 5.5 (AA 36) and GPT-6 Luna (28). [high]
  7. Mythos 5.2 specialist results: CVE Rediscovery 89.6%, up from 78.3% for the previous generation. ExploitGym 39.2%, below Carbon's 53.5%. See Table 2-2. [medium]
  8. A stronger Model 4 exists internally: AECI 178.78 vs. 177.12 for Mythos 5.2. Not released. [high]
  9. Strongest outside the frontier: Muse Wonder Full, AA 50. That is 15 points behind the frontier leader, Fable 5.2 (65). It has no API and is only available through Meta's subscription; the strongest model you can call through an API is Kimi K3.1 Pro (46), 19 behind. [high]
  10. Cheapest tier, $0.10 / $0.50: Muse Ember ties Haiku 5.5. Both score 36 on AA. On the Vals Index, Ember gets 60.48% to Haiku's 58.73%, at $0.15 per task versus $3.17, about 20 times cheaper. See Fig 4-4. [high]
  11. Best open weights: Kimi K3.1 Pro, AA 46. That is 13 ahead of the runner-up, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (33). But it ships under Moonshot's own license: MaaS businesses with more than $20M in revenue need a separate agreement. The strongest MIT-licensed model is V4.1-Flash-1017. See Table 3-1. [high]

n.zh: AA 指数（Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index）

d.zh: 评测机构 Artificial Analysis 做的综合分。把编码、文档处理、科学推理等 9 项测试合成一个 0–100 的分数。它由第三方统一测，所以不同厂商的模型可以直接比。
d.en: A composite score from evaluator Artificial Analysis that rolls 9 tests (coding, document work, scientific reasoning and more) into one 0–100 number. Because a third party runs it the same way for everyone, models from different vendors compare directly.

d.zh: 评测机构 Vals AI 做的综合分。题目来自金融、法律、编码等真实工作任务。它看的是模型能不能把一件实际工作做对，同时公布每题花多少钱。
d.en: A composite score from evaluator Vals AI built from real work tasks in finance, law, coding and more. It asks whether a model gets an actual job done right, and it also publishes the cost per task.

d.zh: 一套难度很高的编码测试。模型要在真实代码库里独立完成复杂改动。目前最好的模型也只做对一半左右。
d.en: A very hard coding test in which the model must make complex changes in a real codebase on its own. Even the best models solve only about half.

d.zh: 测模型能否像员工一样，独立做完一整件多步骤的职业任务。它衡量的是「能不能放手交给它」。
d.en: Tests whether a model can finish a whole multi-step professional task on its own, like an employee would. It measures whether you can safely hand the job off.

d.zh: 让模型在命令行里完成科研计算任务，比如跑模拟、处理实验数据。它衡量模型做科研助手的能力。
d.en: Has the model do scientific computing in a terminal, such as running simulations or processing experimental data. It measures how useful the model is as a research assistant.

d.zh: 让模型像人一样看屏幕、点鼠标、敲键盘来操作电脑。它衡量模型替人操作软件的能力。
d.en: Has the model operate a computer the way a person does: reading the screen, clicking and typing. It measures how well a model can drive software for you.

d.zh: 让模型读信息密集的专业图表并回答问题。它衡量模型「看图说对话」的能力。
d.en: Has the model read dense professional charts and answer questions about them. It measures whether the model reads figures correctly.

d.zh: Zapier 出的测试。模型要跨多个办公软件完成一条业务流程，比如收到邮件后建工单再通知同事。
d.en: A test from Zapier: the model completes a business workflow across several office apps, e.g. turning an incoming email into a ticket and then notifying a colleague.

d.zh: 模型处理文字的计量单位。一个汉字约 1–2 个 token，一个英文词约 1.3 个。API 按输入和输出的 token 数分别收费。
d.en: The unit models use to count text. A Chinese character is about 1–2 tokens, an English word about 1.3. APIs bill input and output tokens separately.

d.zh: 模型回答前「想多久」的档位，常见有 low、medium、high、xhigh、max。档位越高，分数通常越高，但更慢、更贵。同一模型不同档位的分数可以差 10 分以上。
d.en: How long the model "thinks" before answering, usually low, medium, high, xhigh or max. Higher settings usually score better but are slower and pricier; one model's scores can differ by 10+ points across settings.

n.zh: API（Application Programming Interface，应用程序接口）

d.zh: 开发者用代码调用模型的入口。这里的价格都是 API 价，按用量付费，不是 App 的月费。
d.en: The way developers call a model from code. Prices here are API list prices, billed by usage, not app subscriptions.

d.zh: Google 给网络安全防御方的优先试用项目。新模型先给这批人用，再对外开放。
d.en: Google's early-access program for cyber defenders. New models go to this group first before opening to everyone.

d.zh: 一套固定的题目，用来给不同模型打分比较。
d.en: A fixed set of tasks used to score and compare models.

d.zh: 一家独立的 AI 评测机构。它在模型发布前后测模型的自主能力。2026 年 11 月 5 日，它发布了一份对 Anthropic 内部研发加速情况的独立评估，里面第一次出现 Model 2、Model 3、Model 4 这三个代号。
d.en: An independent AI evaluator that tests models' autonomous capabilities before and after release. On November 5, 2026 it published an independent assessment of AI R&D acceleration inside Anthropic, the first public mention of the codenames Model 2, Model 3 and Model 4.

d.zh: 模型厂商随新模型发布的测试报告。里面写了发布前做过哪些能力测试和安全测试，以及结果。
d.en: The test report a vendor publishes with a new model, describing the capability and safety evaluations run before release and their results.

n.zh: CVE（Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures，公开漏洞库）

d.zh: 全球通用的软件漏洞编号库。CVE Rediscovery 这项测试让模型在代码里重新找出库里已有的真实漏洞，分数是找回的比例。
d.en: The global catalog of numbered software vulnerabilities. The CVE Rediscovery test has the model re-find real, already-catalogued vulnerabilities in code; the score is the share it finds.

d.zh: Anthropic 基于 Epoch AI 的能力指数改的综合分。它把很多测试合成一个数，用来看模型能力的增长趋势。
d.en: Anthropic's composite score adapted from Epoch AI's capabilities index. It folds many tests into one number to track how model capability grows over time.

d.zh: Anthropic 加在模型外层的限制，用来拦截网络攻击、生物武器这类高风险请求。Fable 5.2 带全套防护。Mythos 5.2 对通过审核的机构放开其中一部分。
d.en: Restrictions Anthropic layers around a model to block high-risk requests such as cyberattacks or bioweapons. Fable 5.2 ships with the full set; Mythos 5.2 relaxes some of them for vetted organizations.

n.zh: HLE（Humanity's Last Exam，人类最后的考试）

d.zh: 几千道各学科专家出的超难题，专门挑现有模型答不出的。带工具＝允许搜索和跑代码。分数高说明知识和推理的上限高。
d.en: Several thousand very hard questions written by experts across fields, chosen because existing models fail them. "With tools" means search and code execution are allowed. A high score means a high ceiling on knowledge and reasoning.

d.zh: Datacurve 出的编码测试：在真实开源仓库里修 bug，按测试是否通过判分。看的是模型能不能独立改好一个陌生的代码库。
d.en: A coding test from Datacurve: fix bugs in real open-source repositories, graded by whether the tests pass. It shows whether a model can work through an unfamiliar codebase on its own.

d.zh: 从零写出完整的程序，再用一大批测试检查。本报告只取「几乎做对」口径：一题测试通过 95% 以上才算做出。
d.en: Write a complete program from scratch, then check it against a large test suite. This report uses only the "almost solved" metric: a task counts once at least 95% of its tests pass.

d.zh: 长程编码测试：每题要模型连续干好几个小时。看的是长时间工作不跑偏的能力。
d.en: A long-horizon coding test where each task keeps the model working for hours. It shows whether a model stays on track over a long stretch.

d.zh: Artificial Analysis 版的 GDPval：拿几十种职业的真实工作任务，让模型两两比谁做得好，用 Elo 打分。看的是能不能替人干活。
d.en: Artificial Analysis's version of GDPval: real work tasks from dozens of occupations, with models compared head-to-head and scored by Elo. It shows whether a model can do a professional's job.

d.zh: 源自国际象棋的相对评分：两两比较，赢了加分、输了扣分。只有分差有意义；榜上模型一变，同一个模型的分数也会漂。
d.en: A relative rating borrowed from chess: compare two at a time, gain points for a win, lose them for a loss. Only the gaps mean anything, and a model's rating drifts as the field changes.

d.zh: 网络安全测试：给出真实开源软件里的漏洞描述，让模型写出能触发漏洞的输入。分数高也意味着攻击能力强，所以多数是关掉防护测的。
d.en: A cybersecurity test: given a description of a real vulnerability in open-source software, write an input that triggers it. A high score also means strong offensive capability, so it is mostly run with safeguards off.

n.zh: MaaS（Model as a Service，模型即服务）

d.zh: 把模型包装成 API 卖给别人用的生意。开放权重的许可证常对这类大客户另加条件，比如收入过线要另签协议。
d.en: The business of selling a model to others through an API. Open-weight licenses often add terms for big players here, such as a separate agreement above a revenue threshold.

d.zh: 把训练好的模型参数文件公开，任何人都能下载、自己部署和微调。不等于公开训练数据和代码；能不能商用要看许可证。
d.en: The trained model's parameter files are published, so anyone can download, self-host and fine-tune it. That is not the same as releasing the training data or code, and commercial use depends on the license.

d.zh: 最宽松的开源许可证之一：可以商用、修改、再发布，只要保留版权声明，没有别的条件。
d.en: One of the most permissive open-source licenses: commercial use, modification and redistribution are allowed as long as the copyright notice is kept, with no other conditions.
